source_title: AI Video: AI Video Generator — US App Store
observation: The US listing showed about 24K ratings, a 4.5 rating and a current Photo & Video chart position near number 12, supporting active image-to-video behavior but not revenue.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: Ratings and chart position do not disclose downloads, revenue, retention or acquisition cost.

source_title: AI Video: AI Video Generator — in-app purchases
observation: The listing showed weekly purchase options around $4.99-$14.99 plus coin packs, demonstrating a monetization pattern while leaving realized payment and refund rates unobserved.
denominator: in-app purchase options shown on listing
limitations: List prices are not transactions or sustainable unit economics.

source_title: AI Video visible US App Store review on old-photo use
data_period: reviews visible on listing at access
observation: A visible reviewer described animating photos of people who had died and wanted more serious old-photo motion instead of novelty dancing, directly supporting a respectful family-memory wedge.
limitations: One selected review cannot establish segment prevalence or product preference.

source_title: AI Video visible US App Store failure reviews
data_period: reviews visible on listing at access
observation: Visible reviews reported identity distortion, failed processing and extra coin consumption after subscribing, making identity preservation and automatic failure refunds critical quality gates.
unit: named failure themes in visible reviews
limitations: Quick Scan did not perform stratified review mining; theme frequency is not estimated.

source_title: Motionleap: 3D Photo Animator — US App Store
observation: Motionleap showed about 117K ratings and a 4.8 rating, indicating a strong incumbent in photo animation and raising the bar for a generic feature set.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: Rating count does not quantify active users or switching costs.

source_title: Revive: AI Face Photo Animator — US App Store
observation: Revive showed about 25K ratings, a 4.7 rating and both weekly and lifetime purchase options, supporting episodic use economics more than mandatory ongoing subscription retention.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: The listing does not reveal purchase mix or repeat use.

observation: Kling showed about 26K ratings, a 4.7 rating and a number-one Graphics & Design category position, confirming current user attention while also showing intense incumbent competition.
denominator: US App Store ratings displayed at access
limitations: A competitor chart position does not prove that a narrow family-memory product can acquire users.

source_title: US iPhone Photo & Video free chart
observation: An AI video generator appeared around number 12 in the current US Photo & Video free chart, a time-sensitive signal that photo-to-video remains active rather than purely historical.
denominator: US iPhone Photo & Video free chart
limitations: Chart positions can change quickly and do not disclose revenue.

observation: Runway documents $0.01 per credit and model rates implying roughly $0.25-$0.60 for a five-second generation on selected models, before retries, storage, payment fees and support.
unit: USD estimated provider charge per five-second generation for selected models
denominator: official price per credit multiplied by documented credits per second
limitations: Actual delivered cost depends on provider, resolution, retries, failed jobs and model changes.

observation: The catalog listed multiple image-to-video providers with materially different five-second prices, supporting provider choice but also exposing model dependency and quality-cost variability.
unit: USD observed approximate five-second price range across selected listed models
denominator: selected image-to-video model listings visible at access
limitations: Catalog availability and prices change; public prices do not guarantee acceptable family-photo identity fidelity.

observation: The proposed product accepts only user-selected photos, avoids public figures and deceptive speech, uses three bounded non-speaking motion modes, discloses AI processing and promises automatic deletion; these constraints avoid an obvious blocked use case but require implementation verification.
limitations: A written scope is not proof of safe model outputs, consent or deletion behavior.
